title: Note carrier
description: What the frontmatter of a carrier in a `notes/` artifact-role directory says about it: what it is called and about, when it was written, which section owns it, what it asserts about other terms, and what it cites. The directory states the kind; glossary term records are held to the term schema instead. Keys beyond these are admitted; relation keys are the relation vocabulary's predicates, folded in by the admitter that compiles this schema.

description.description: One or two sentences saying what the note is about, for readers and retrieval.

date-created.description: The date the note was first written, ISO 8601.

type.description: The kind of note: note, article, explanation, bibliography, research-article, and so on.

science-owner.description: The services section whose science the note belongs to.

visibility.description: Only public opts a note into the anonymous surface.
